notes.title: Steam Cloud Saves are now ENABLED for Hypnospace Outlaw!
notes.content:
Hey enforcers!

LONG TIME NO SEE!

We’ve got a small update for you regarding Steam Cloud Saves, which we’ve finally enabled for Hypnospace Outlaw! There’s a couple of important details we wanted to share with you, so you’re across all of it:


 Once your saves are synced via Steam Cloud, the save files uploaded to the cloud will be considered your canonical save files, and they will sync automatically (as long as you have an internet connection), overwriting any previous, local saves. If you've purchased and installed Hypnospace via Itch, GOG, or otherwise in addition to Steam, this will overwrite those save files as well!!

 Any mods installed on one device must be installed on your other device(s) BEFORE you load the save file!! Otherwise mod-related save data may be lost, and in some cases may break your save

 If you’re playing on a Linux device or Steam Deck, when you load your save on a Windows or Mac, Hypii will have his text-to-speech (TTS) turned OFF, because Hypnospace on Linux does not support TTS. To resolve this, when you load your save file on your Windows/Mac device, open the Settings app -> Audio tab -> Robot Language Only: toggle to OFF; Caption All Hypii Speech: toggle to OFF.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/883cf05dd040ec08147743535c644461d2ce84a2.gif

And that’s pretty much all there is to it! Now you’ll easily be able to access your Hypnospace Steam save data wherever you go, as long as there’s no violations involved, of course

Thanks for tuning into this small update! We might be working on Dreamsettler but we haven’t abandoned support for HynOS just yet…

Speaking of Dreamsettler, DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST OR YOU DON'T STAND WITH GOOPER


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931040/Dreamsettler/

notes.title: Update: PUBG Mobile's latest skin being renamed to remove reference to Hypnospace Outlaw
notes.content:
Update: The developers of PUBG Mobile reached out to Hypnospace Outlaw creator Jay Tholen to explain the situation via Twitter. Apparently the skin's original name in Mandarin translates to "Golden Diva" and was designed without Tholen's work in mind. However, "An individual on our localization team saw the visuals for the skin and was reminded of your game. Rather than adopt the literal translation, 'Golden Diva,' the team member decided to change the name to Hypnospace Diva, not considering the consequences or implications of doing so. Those responsible for approving the localization were not familiar with Hypnospace Outlaw, and so were unaware of the name's connection to your game."..

notes.title: HypnOS v2.34 and OST Vol. 3 are here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We're so excited with how much you've all been loving Hypnospace Plus! Thank you for sharing your experiences with us on discord, twitter, in the forums and our emails. We've loved every minute of watching you rediscover Hypnospace! To celebrate, we're releasing our newest patch and Vol. 3 of the OST!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/60276d3cfaa7b722b20f1f7f89cd915824848a02.png

For the last little while the team have been hard at work clearing up pesky bugs and adding in EVEN MORE neat content for you to find! 

Here's what's new in HypnOS v2.34:

- More than a dozen unheard music tracks (these are ALL amazing)
- Performance improvements
- A bunch of minor fixes on pages (thank you for all your reports on these!)
- Boot-up now shows "HypnOS+"
- Tunebox now uses case insensitive sorting
- Credits updated
- Game engine updated to NWJS 0.49.0 

BUGS FIXED:

- Weird graphics bugs with videos (again, thank you so much for all your reports and help getting this one fixed up!)
- Long splash-screen loading times on low-spec machines no longer soft-lock the game
- Hammering content during a page transition no longer disables all user input
- No longer possible for your Hypnocoin wallet to go into the negative
- Pets can no longer poop offscreen (but they do still poop, sorry about that)
- Unintentional Axx. sequence break disabled
- Status bar/text above Hypnospace user pages no longer goes offscreen
- Soft lock in Outlaw when pausing at specific times fixed
- Issues with Tunebox music file importing fixed

The soundtrack also now includes Vol. 3 of the soundtrack! This means there are now 146 TRACKS in there, which is an INSANE amount! 

Have fun listening and playing, and as always let us know how you get on!  xoxo

notes.title: Hypnospace PLUS is here!
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! Super excited to bring you the HYPNOSPACE PLUS UPDATE! This is a HUGE update that's been in the works since launch and has been a real labour of love - so we hope you enjoy it as much as everyone enjoyed working on it! It's entirely free, so make sure your game has updated before you boot it up next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/883cf05dd040ec08147743535c644461d2ce84a2.gif

So what's included? WELL! 

> 60+ NEW PAGES
This has been a MASSIVE undertaking, but there are now a ton of new pages to find. Many of them are hidden away and unlisted, so you'll need to hunt them down, but we think it's well worth it! 

We've also updated a bunch of places we thought were lacking, so make sure you keep a beady eye open for some new content, like over at Counsellor Ronnie's!

> 2+ Hours of NEW MUSIC
We couldn't resist bringing back your favourites, so there are 2 hours of previously unreleased music headed your way! If you find you really enjoy it, you'll be able to get your hands on it soon as part of Hypnospace Vol. 3 and through each artist's own stores!

> New Cursors & Desktop Themes
There weren't enough ways to make your personal Hypnospace look the best it could possibly be. 

Now there are almost enough ways.

> New Apps & Games to discover
We honestly couldn't resist the cries for a certain character to be added in and interactable with, and then they carried on. There are a bunch more ways to get involved with Hypnospace now, and we can't wait for you to discover them all! 

> Much improved Linux support
We've been working closely with the community on making the Linux build much more stable, and we're happy to announce we're making those changes public! If you've been getting errors and launch failures, this version should hopefully fix those! Let us know if you run into any more problems! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/8e711af583c01ed42513414693a3fc2172c86f38.png

Thanks again for all your support since launch. We've been touched by your stories, laughed at your memes and enjoyed every second of watching and hearing about you play! Let us know when you find something new!

notes.title: The Modding Update is coming November 19th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/b4449e9c593eae499c670f03a011b9c008dbcf9d.png

We've been talking about it for a while, and it's finally time to open the floodgates - the Hypnospace Outlaw Modding Update will be launching on November 19th, along with some super cool mods to get you into the mood (anyone fancy some more Seepage?)


Using an in-game menu built especially for Mod.io, you'll be able to download mods you're interested in and give them a whirl. We know we talked about using Steam Workshop previously, but we're excited by the possibilities that Mod.io gives us and we promise it's really easy to use!

We've made sure that come the 19th there'll be some cool things for you to try as well as some guides to get you started, even if you've not modded a game before. If you find you're looking for more help or to collaborate with others, we've also got a channel in the Discord for advice, asking questions and inspirations!

From themes to hacks, music to whole new storylines, this will be a chance to make Hypnospace YOURS, and tell YOUR story, however you'd like! 

We can't WAIT to see what you create - see you on the 19th ;)

notes.title: Trading Cards now live & 5 things you might have missed in Hypnospace!
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

Hypnospace has been out for a month now, and we're totally blown away but the wonderful support you've been showing the game. We've received so many kind messages and pieces of fan art, it's been a really amazing experience to see you all jumping into the world of Hypnospace!

To celebrate,  we've set up some trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges, and thought we'd share some of our favourite, slightly more hidden pages that you might have missed! 


1. Worms?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/4eee25608f6f9ab7cdae9aab66c2c3db957d3f43.jpg
In Chapter 1 there's a pretty out-there blog, though it looks like some enforcer has already taken a disliking to it. With the calibre of pictures left behind, we kinda wonder - what on earth did the other pictures look like? =/

2. Fan Art contest
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/91e01412cd5b84da5dc7ddf14433444888a26c2c.jpg
All across Hypnospace, there are stories of people connecting for the first time and expressing themselves for the first time. One of those that touched our heart was 'RebeRuthPin' who adores Squisherz so much she joins a fan art contest - her story is definitely worth reading and following across chapters.

3. Smoulder Boulder interactive fiction
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/d30d4ca9d46418853279669dfe7380ea9760a105.jpg
Looking for a well-written pick your own adventure game with stunning accompanying graphics? Well DarkTwilightTiff has you covered with the chilling based-on-true-events tale of the Smoulder Boulder 

4. Bees?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/cd06403c22e6a933fba7cebd06003623717fad5e.jpg
Two bee fanatics have set up their pages and are now... at war? 
Over BEES?
Yeah, we're not sure either. 


5. Discord
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/d9fdd4b46b36ade0ad022be3b278d5f3a8340e90.jpg
Our lovely Discord community played a metagame on the run-up to the game's release, and some of them earned having their pages and songs added to the game! Searching Discord will bring these up - they range from Silly to Spooky, and we love every single one! 

If your favourites aren't listed here, feel free to let us know about them, and thank you again for being a part of the wonderful Hypnospace World!

notes.title: What's next for Hypnospace?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32660404/966d0828ac69bc08cac7f3de15b733998dc5700f.png
Hey everyone!

Hypnospace Outlaw has been available for 3 days now, and we've been blown away by the response. We've had multiple press outlets calling it a Game of the Year Contender, tons of YouTube videos, livestreams, and even a video from someone who attempted to make Granny Cream's Hot Butter Ice-Cream: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4bE-Q7C6iXc
Thanks so much for all your support -- we're glad you're all loving the game so much, and we're now excited to talk about what comes next!

MAKE YOUR OWN HYPNOSPACE WEBPAGES AND SONGS

In preparation for the upcoming Steam Workshop Update (more on this in a sec), here's your chance to make webpages and songs that will feature in the game!

Simply download the Hypnospace Productivity Suite (fully endorsed by Merchantsoft, Windows only), and use the Hypnospace Page Builder and Hypnospace Tune Sequencer to create great webpages and tracks for the game: https://jay-tholen.itch.io/hsps

You can then simply drop the .hsp file into a directory in /hs/ in the game files, to see your pages in the game! Eg. drop your page in data/hs/01_goodtime valley/, and hey presto, your page in is Goodtime Valley.

But that's not all! You'll soon be able to upload these for other players to find and share... speaking of which...

THE STEAM WORKSHOP UPDATE

With the upcoming Steam Workshop Update, you'll then be able to offer your creations to other Hypnospace users. Anyone who owns the game will be able to download your websites and songs, and will their Hypnospace browser with your wonderment.

We're aiming to have the Steam Workshop Update ready for this summer (along with an update for the Productivity Suite), which should give you enough time to build a whole bunch of fantastic pages, ready for injection into the Hypnospace world.

We'll let you all know when this update is ready! It will, of course, be a completely free update you'll simply download through Steam.

EXTRA SECRETS AND SILLINESS

Over the course of the next month, we'll be updating the game with extra webpages and silliness to find -- some out in the open, and some hidden behind keywords you'll need to search.

We love the idea of Hypnospace evolving over time, and it gives you more reasons to come back to the game again in the future. 

We're also aware of a bunch of bugs and fixes that need swatting -- thanks to everyone who has posted on the Steam forums and in the Hypnospace Discord (discord.gg/hypnospace).

We'll be working over the next weeks to kill all these issues dead, so if you see some small updates for the game, it'll most likely be a combination of new little extras, and bug-killing.

That's all for now -- thanks again to everyone who has played. Here's a little present before we sign off: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hY8S6mF6evQ
Love from
Jay, Mike, Mike, Nelson and Pip
